title: SDED Protocol Specification: Substantive-Description Eponym Deprecation
description: The SDED (Substantive-Description Eponym Deprecation) Protocol defines a standardized linguistic framework for descriptor-first scientific naming. It replaces arbitrary and commemorative eponyms with explicit, phenomenological descriptors to restore epistemic transparency across scientific, technical, and pedagogical contexts. Names constructed under SDED consist of a Substantive-Description followed by the legacy eponym in parentheses with a TM mark and year of establishment.
